titleStmt.title: Shiji 史记 · 秦孝文王元年: introductions

div.p: The Basic Annals for 250 BC: the entry of the Basic Annals of Qin under the first year of King Xiaowen, his acts on accession, his three-day reign and his death.
The entry of the Hereditary House of Zhao for this year: Lian Po's siege of Yan and Yue Cheng's title.
The lines of the Biography of Lian Po and Lin Xiangru on the defeat of Yan and Lian Po's enfeoffment, given under this year as well, in which the Hereditary House of Zhao places the siege of Yan.
The lines of the Biography of Lü Buwei on the death of King Xiaowen, the accession of King Zhuangxiang and the two Queens Dowager.
